BounceJacobian.contactX.definition: fun g κ v p => p.1 + BounceJacobian.flightTime g κ v p * p.2

BounceJacobian.flightDenominator.definition: fun g κ p => g + κ * p.2 ^ 2

BounceJacobian.flightLinear.definition: fun g v => BounceJacobian.dx + (2 * v / g) • BounceJacobian.du

BounceJacobian.flightNumerator.definition: fun g κ v p => BounceJacobian.launchSpeed g κ v p - κ * p.1 * p.2

BounceJacobian.flightTime.definition: fun g κ v p => 2 * BounceJacobian.flightNumerator g κ v p / BounceJacobian.flightDenominator g κ p

BounceJacobian.gap.definition: fun g κ v p t =>   BounceJacobian.wall κ p.1 + BounceJacobian.launchSpeed g κ v p * t - g * t ^ 2 / 2 -     BounceJacobian.wall κ (p.1 + t * p.2)
BounceJacobian.gap.type: ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → BounceJacobian.Phase → ℝ → ℝ

BounceJacobian.horizontalReflection.definition: fun s u w =>   have n₁ := -s / √(1 + s ^ 2);   have n₂ := 1 / √(1 + s ^ 2);   u - 2 * (u * n₁ + w * n₂) * n₁

BounceJacobian.incomingZ.definition: fun g κ v p => BounceJacobian.launchSpeed g κ v p - g * BounceJacobian.flightTime g κ v p

BounceJacobian.jacobian.definition: fun g κ v =>   ContinuousLinearMap.prod (BounceJacobian.flightLinear g v)     (BounceJacobian.du - (2 * v * κ) • BounceJacobian.flightLinear g v)

BounceJacobian.launchSpeed.definition: fun g κ v p => √(BounceJacobian.radicand g κ v p)

BounceJacobian.radicand.definition: fun g κ v p => v ^ 2 - g * κ * p.1 ^ 2 - p.2 ^ 2

BounceJacobian.returnMap.definition: fun g κ v p =>   (BounceJacobian.contactX g κ v p,     BounceJacobian.horizontalReflection (BounceJacobian.slope g κ v p) p.2 (BounceJacobian.incomingZ g κ v p))

BounceJacobian.slope.definition: fun g κ v p => κ * BounceJacobian.contactX g κ v p
